passage_layout: Read papers in source order. at is section.paragraph; only adjacent numbers in the same section are neighbors. Judge rows marked focus or candidate (including groups), not context_only rows. A candidate group is one option across all its members. Positions are not evidence of a match.
text_reference_contract: Every full_text_refs list is the complete original text: look up each ID in source_texts in list order and join with two newline characters. Read all referenced text. References share storage only, not candidate identity.
candidate_handle_suffix: Return only the candidate handle required by the matching instructions, never a text ID.
